work.author: David Hilbert
later_reference_editions: 1900 French translation by L. Laugel (Gauthier-Villars, Paris) — adds Axiom of Completeness (Vollständigkeit) and Max Dehn's Conclusion note
1903 Second German Edition (B. G. Teubner, Leipzig) — incorporates Vollständigkeitsaxiom (V 2) and Dehn's non-Archimedean polyhedra theorem

1930 Seventh German Edition (B. G. Teubner, Leipzig) — swaps Groups III (Congruence) and IV (Parallels), drops redundant Axiom II 4 (becoming Satz 5, shifting 1899 Satz 4 to Satz 6), renames flächengleich to zerlegungsgleich, and specializes Streckenübertrager to Eichmass; cited by P. Hoenen, S.J. (1954)
